_comment: Per-container-type model + effort defaults. Layered like versions.env: this tracked file is the base, and an untracked ~/.research-sandbox/model-defaults.json overrides it PER KEY (a partial override file is fine — only the types it names are replaced). Every type resolves independently; there is no inheritance between types. The four project types are also overridable per-invocation at project create, box add, and the dev card; `reviewer` (the ephemeral dev-lane reviewer) has no per-invocation knob — it is read live at each review run and edited from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Reviewer (rscore.model_default_set writes the override); `referee` is set there too, frozen into each researcher-subagents project at create, and changed per project in its ⚙ Agents box.
_referee: The independent referee of a finding in a researcher-subagents project (rs-memory referee, Claude). Sonnet at high effort was measured adequate on 2026-11-22: it caught a planted overreach for about $0.04 per finding (Opus at high: about $0.11). Frozen into those projects' record at create; set here from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Referee, and per project in its ⚙ Agents box.
